role: typed direct chain launch/admission/state writer; shell compatibility filename only
entrypoint: runner-v2-direct-run <chain.json> [--workspace <path>] [--task <id>] [--start <agent-id>] [--dry-run] [--debug]; chain-runner.sh immediately execs that CLI
owns: chain json validation and agent ref resolution
does_not_own: branch routing after an agent emits
watchdog or chain-watcher lifecycle; web/server/background-worker.ts owns both typed services

run_json.typed_session_start: promotes run to running and upserts agent session
run_json.typed_startup_failure: marks agent/run failed or blocked without sending instructions

session_contract.agent_session: typed PTY transport starts the configured agent with an explicit run context
session_contract.monitor_session: typed bootstrap starts monitor-<agent-session> with an allowlisted run context
session_contract.instructions: typed bootstrap writes artifact instructions and sends a short pointer to the TUI

readiness.gate: typed bootstrap readiness policy must pass before task instructions are sent
readiness.classification_order: blocked_patterns, recoverable_patterns, retry_patterns, ready_patterns; first enabled match wins
readiness.typed_default: the typed readiness policy determines whether disabled, unknown, or zero ready_patterns can proceed
readiness.fail_closed: unknown keeps polling and blocks at the deadline when the typed policy requires readiness
readiness.startup_recovery: typed startup recovery is bounded for blocked/recover/retry; no_ready_signal escalates immediately
readiness.terminal_effects: write typed startup evidence, mark the run agent blocked, send no instructions, and leave actionable sessions available
readiness.exited: a session with no active command is failed before instructions are sent

session_contract.local_remote_split: typed direct launch supports local workspaces; SSH and Docker fail closed until their typed owner is selected

invariants: run.json writers use the shared lock protocol
startup failure must not paste instructions into idle shell
readiness classification is profile-driven data, never hardcoded prompt heuristics (a7956d9, 20ce3b1)
best-effort observability writers (perf/metrics/profiler) must never abort a live run under set -e + ERR trap (23bdfe7)
diagnostic monitor events must not look like successful handoff events
completion/routing is delegated to the typed completion entrypoint
